notes: §1985:XV.3.2.2 prints USE FOR DEBUGGING ON { cd-name-1 | [ALL REFERENCES OF] identifier-1 | file-name-1 | procedure-name-1 | ALL PROCEDURES } ..., only USE, DEBUGGING and ALL underlined. The grammar's useStatement arm (USE FOR? DEBUGGING ON? useDebugTarget+) and useDebugTarget (ALL PROCEDURES | ALL REFERENCES? OF? dataReference | dataReference) carry the format, ProcedureTableBuilder.FinalizeDebug sorts each operand into cd, data, file and procedure subjects, and VersionConformancePass.VisitUseStatement refuses the declarative from 2002 on (COBOL0902, probed). Probes at --std 85: one statement naming a cd-name, ALL REFERENCES OF V, W, a file-name and a paragraph compiles and fires each (also written 'USE DEBUGGING OUT-CD ALL V W F1 P2', with separators, and as 'ALL REFERENCES W'), a qualified 'P2 OF MAIN' fires; zero operands, a literal operand and ALL REFERENCES OF with no identifier are refused. The operand-uniqueness and placement syntax rules are other rows (kb/Work PB5081).

next.reason: 1985: "USE FOR DEBUGGING ON { cd-name-1 | [ALL REFERENCES OF] identifier-1 | file-name-1 | procedure-name-1 | ALL PROCEDURES }"; 2023: "The 2023 USE statement rules cover only exception (EC/EO, file), AFTER EXCEPTION and BEFORE REPORTING forms; none has FOR DEBUGGING.". The candidates cover the 2023 USE statement, and none of its forms is FOR DEBUGGING. The Debug module's USE FOR DEBUGGING format is no longer part of 2023.
